WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT ordersmark, AVG(fillcount) AS avg_fillcount
  FROM orderexecutions
  GROUP BY ordersmark
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_fillcount) AS overall_avg
  FROM step1
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT step1.ordersmark, step1.avg_fillcount,
         step1.avg_fillcount - step2.overall_avg AS difference
  FROM step1 CROSS JOIN step2
  WHERE step1.avg_fillcount > step2.overall_avg
),
step4 AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_fillcount) AS step3_avg
  FROM step3
),
step5 AS (
  SELECT step3.ordersmark, step3.avg_fillcount, step3.difference,
         step3.avg_fillcount - step4.step3_avg AS difference_from_step3_avg
  FROM step3 CROSS JOIN step4
  WHERE step3.avg_fillcount > step4.step3_avg
)
SELECT AVG(avg_fillcount), AVG(difference), AVG(difference_from_step3_avg)
FROM step5
